title: Town Councils' Enforcement Actions against Unlawful Parking in Common Areas by Foreign-registered Vehicles
what_it_is: Town Councils' Enforcement Actions against Unlawful Parking in Common Areas by Foreign-registered Vehicles

sections.label: Town Council by-law enforcement
sections.summary: Breaching Town Council by-laws is an offence, and councils decide enforcement against illegally parked vehicles, including foreign-registered ones, with HDB and LTA help.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: A breach of any of a Town Council’s by-laws is an offence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Town Councils Act does not differentiate between foreign- and local-registered vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Town Councils have the autonomy to decide how they wish to enforce their by-laws, including those pertaining to unlawful parking in common areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Enforcement actions against vehicles found parked illegally on common property can include issuing notices of offence, removing, or detaining the vehicles, if the Town Council is empowered to do so under its by-laws.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Town Councils can approach HDB and LTA for assistance if they require information about foreign-registered vehicles for their enforcement efforts.

sections.label: Vehicle clamping and fine payment
sections.summary: Some Town Councils, if by-laws allow, clamp vehicles and require owners to pay fines at the council office before release.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: My understanding is that some Town Councils, if their by-laws allow, also detain the vehicle by clamping and require the vehicle owner to pay the fine at the Town Council's office before the vehicle is released back to them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: That is also another way in which enforcement can be done.
